Bihar CM Clarifies Toll Tax Exemption for Private Vehicles

Bihar Chief Minister Nitish Kumar has clarified that private vehicles will be exempt from toll tax on state highways. This clarification comes amidst a controversy regarding the imposition of toll taxes. The Chief Minister stated that only commercial vehicles will be required to pay the toll.
